title: UpsertPetition
description: A public petition from an official register (ECI, parliament platforms). Top-level texts are the English version; `versions` carries every language the register publishes, the original among them (see title_lang). Organizer names come from the upstream public register (Art 6(1)(e)); e-mail addresses are never carried, nor data-protection officers. Milestone dates are flattened for chart/query ergonomics; per-country counts and per-sponsor funding ride as parallel arrays.

objectives.description: The English objectives in full, as plain text (paragraphs and list items on lines of their own).

answer_refs.description: Raw answer document refs, e.g. C(2026)4110

title_lang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the version the initiative was registered in (the register's `original` version).

annex_text.description: The English annex in full, as plain text: the organisers' longer explanation, where they gave one.

treaties.description: The English text naming the Treaty provisions the initiative relies on.

decision_url.description: The registration decision in this language.

versions.description: Every language version the register publishes, keyed by ISO 639-1 code: official texts, not machine translations.

categories.description: The register's subject codes, e.g. ENV, JUST, SANTE.

register_id.description: The register's numeric id of the initiative (its API's `id`).

register_url.description: The initiative's public page on the register.

online_supporters.description: Statements of support collected online, as last reported (sosReport.totalSignatures).

supporters_updated_at.description: When online_supporters was last reported (ISO date).

supporter_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, parallel to supporter_counts.

supporter_counts.description: Online statements of support per country, parallel to supporter_countries.

verified_supporters.description: Statements of support verified by the member states, at submission.

verified_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, parallel to verified_counts.

verified_counts.description: Verified statements per country, parallel to verified_countries.

verified_after_submission.description: Per verified country: reported after the submission, parallel to verified_countries.

ongoing_date.description: When the initiative entered ONGOING (ISO date).

insufficient_support_date.description: When it closed without enough support (ISO date).

insufficient_support_after_verification_.description: When verification found too few valid statements (ISO date).

early_closure_date.description: When the organisers closed collection early (ISO date).

partially_registered.description: Registered for part of what it asked.

sponsor_names.description: Sponsors as the register names them ('[ANONYMIZED]' where upstream anonymised them); parallel arrays.

sponsor_amounts_eur.description: Per sponsor, in euros, parallel to sponsor_names.

sponsor_dates.description: Per sponsor, ISO date, parallel to sponsor_names.

sponsor_private.description: Per sponsor: a private person, parallel to sponsor_names.

sponsor_anonymized.description: Per sponsor: anonymised upstream, parallel to sponsor_names.

sponsor_other_support.description: Per sponsor: support other than money, '' where none, parallel to sponsor_names.

funding_updated_at.description: When the funding was last updated (ISO date).

funding_document_name.description: The funding report's file name, where one is attached.

answer_communication_url.description: The Commission's communication answering the initiative.

registration_decision_corrigendum.description: CELEX number of a corrigendum to the registration decision.

annex_document_name.description: File name of the annex document the organisers attached.

annex_document_id.description: The register's id of that document.

draft_legal_act_name.description: File name of the draft legal act the organisers attached.

draft_legal_act_id.description: The register's id of that document.

representative_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of residence of the organisers' representative.
